title: 2.13 Light blue, dark blue
unit_title: Places, things and how we describe them
unit_outcome: Say where people go and how they get there, talk about the things people have, point things out and compare them, put things in order, and ask about favorites.
goal: Say whether a color is light or dark (My bag is light blue. / The dog is dark brown. / It's dark green.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 2.13 More Colors: A1 adds brown, pink, purple and gray; A1+ 2.13 puts light or dark before a color (light blue, dark blue). Each scene has two photos that differ only in that one color, made as an edit of the first: Ana's bag, Diego's shirt and Luis's dog, light and then dark. It brings back A1+ 2.4's It's (What color is your bag? It's light blue.) and 2.8's favorite (Diego: My favorite color is dark green.).
prerequisite: A1 2.8 and 2.13 colors; A1 What color is it?; A1+ 2.4 It's; A1+ 2.8 favorite; A1 bag, shirt, dog; A1 has.
speaking_outcome: Say light with a clear l and dark with a long a (LIGHT blue, DARK blue). Do not require native-like speed.
